title: OneExtend Grammar Pack
description: Declarative syntax definition for the OneExtend code block renderer

basedOn.description: Parent grammar id; keywords are merged (union), tokens/formatter/detection come from this pack when present

keywords.description: Word lists used to classify identifiers: control / keyword / type / function

type.description: Token type: comment.line, comment.block, string, string.q, string.template, number, keyword, control, type, function, variable, tag, attribute, operator, punctuation, bindvar, substitution, builtin.package, identifier

pattern.description: .NET regular expression, matched in declaration order (first match wins)
